profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google X
profile.summary: I am an AI engineer, systems architect, and tech lead at Google X specializing in 0-to-1 multimodal agent platforms, generative UI, and data visualization. Lately, I’ve focused on scaling autonomous agent fleets and platform architectures that deliver 10x–100x leaps in system performance, developer velocity, and AI reliability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead of 10+ engineers building production agentic AI at Google X: agent platforms, LLM evaluation, AI security, and generative UI. Recognized with 30+ awards.

- Launched a 0-to-1 multimodal agent platform with text-to-image and image-to-image vector search, cutting latency 68% to sub-300ms time-to-first-token
- Designed an LLM evaluation platform with autonomous hill-climbing over 15,000+ trajectories: hallucinations down 82%, multi-turn Pass@1 up 38%, eval runtime from 3 hours to under 30 minutes
- Developed a generative UI component library and real-time streaming runtime with an interactive agent debugger (live token gauges, multi-turn flame graphs, reasoning timelines)
- Engineered enterprise AI security: prompt-injection defense, automated PII redaction, and safety guardrails across 10+ GCP environments
- Scaled autonomous SWE and SRE agent fleets for code review, bug fixes, and on-call triage, quadrupling merged PRs that meet code-quality checks across a 110+ person org
- Accelerated rendering 266x with a WebGL/WebGPU engine (1M+ assets at 110 FPS) and led a 7-team effort that cut build times 100x (200s to under 2s)

Stack: Go, Python, TypeScript, Angular, React, ADK, MCP, RLHF/DPO, Vertex AI, GCP

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Created performant, responsive, and accessible web applications and data visualizations that push the capabilities of web browsers using TypeScript, Three.js, D3.js, RxJS, Angular, Sass, AWS, Java, and ExtJS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented Command Center touch interface using React for the Newseum that was narrated by Wolf Blitzer on Fox and CNN and built from scratch within 4 weeks
- Modernized front end from Backbone and Grunt to React and Webpack; prototyped and shipped first versions of React to production
- Improved development environment by reducing build times (20s to < 1s), adding source-maps, hot reload, and more
- Led development for Zignal's first mobile web application using React, Redux, PostCSS, and Webpack

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description: The previous company I worked at, Ringtail Design, shut down, so I took some time off to travel and work on several freelance projects involving React, Angular, React Native, and Ruby on Rails
